card.name: Dosing schedule wording in regimens
card.fires_on: Words and numbers inside dosing instructions that come right after a dose amount, such as followed, twice, once, times, or a digit in a second dose. Mostly in regimen and dose-adjustment text.

modes.label: Sequence of drugs
modes.description: The word followed linking one drug dose to the next in a combination regimen.

modes.label: Frequency after dose
modes.description: Frequency words such as twice, once, or times right after an amount in mg.
modes.example: A starting dosage of 20 mg<< twice>> daily is recommended for patients with severe liver

modes.label: Second dose in split schedule
modes.description: The number or space starting the second dose amount in a morning and evening split.
modes.example: in the morning and 200 mg orally in the evening about 12 hours apart OR 200 mg orally in the morning and<< >>400 mg orally in the evening
